verdict.rationale: gstack ships its own mechanisms for agents to create skills. /skillify codifies a /scrape intent into a reusable script, and domain-skills let the agent save per-site skills and promote a per-project skill to global scope. These are narrow, domain-specific skill creators rather than a general meta-skill for authoring new skills. Missing for 10: a general-purpose skill-writing guide or meta-skill, documented workflow for improving or iterating on existing skills, packaging/publishing support for new skills, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection ships a meta-skill or tool that guides my agent through writing, improving, and packaging new skills

citations.quote: Future /scrape calls with the same intent run the codified script in ~200ms instead of re-driving the page.
once an agent figures out something non-obvious about a website, it saves a skill, and future sessions on that host get the note injected into their prompt context.
